name: uniform-field-turnaround
description: Closed form: the positive root of v t - a t^2 / 2 + d = 0. An ion launched at 4 keV into a uniform 40 kV/m retarding field, which stops it 100 mm downrange, turns it round and returns it past its launch point to a detector 50 mm behind. The whole path is one parabola, so the arrival time is the positive root of v t - a t^2 / 2 + d = 0. Worth running because the turning point is where a position-error step controller is most likely to under-refine, and the closed form here is exact.
